about: Check-in chat replies for check-society-suggestions.mjs. Regenerate with --refresh rather than edit.

gigs, rules out sport.message: Gigs and live music. Not sport. A gig, then out with mates. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
gigs, rules out sport.reply:
For live music, you might like [[Music]], where you can connect with other musicians and fans.
Have you had a chance to check out what is coming up on the [[Gigs]] page yet?

homebody, rules out partying.message: Board games and reading. Not partying. A quiet night in with a film. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
homebody, rules out partying.reply: For a quiet night in, [[Book]] and [[Film]] might be right up your street. What kind of books or films do you usually enjoy?

sporty early riser.message: Football and the gym. Up early for a run, then football. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
sporty early riser.reply: Since you are into football and running, you might enjoy checking out [[Climbing]] or [[Walking]] for keeping active. Have a look at [[Sport]] as well for joining teams and sports clubs.

lie-in and the cinema.message: Photography and the cinema. A lie-in, then the cinema. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
lie-in and the cinema.reply: Since you like film, you might enjoy [[Film]]. Have a look at what it offers, and let me know if you would like to chat about anything else.

gamer, last minute (near tie).message: Gaming, Minecraft and FIFA. Gaming online late with mates. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
gamer, last minute (near tie).reply:
It sounds like you love gaming, so you might want to take a look at [[Gaming and Roleplay]] or [[Esports]]. 

What sort of games do you usually play with your mates online?

clubbing (synonyms for partying).message: Going clubbing and festivals. Big nights out. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
clubbing (synonyms for partying).reply: For big nights out and music, you might enjoy checking out [[Events]] and [[Gigs]]. What kind of music or festivals are you into?

outdoors, rules out the gym.message: Hiking and climbing. Not the gym. Up early for a long walk. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
outdoors, rules out the gym.reply: That sounds like a great way to spend the morning. For those activities, you might like [[Climbing]], [[Outdoor Climbing]] or [[Walking]]. What do you think of those?

unrelated to every mentor.message: Knitting and birdwatching. A trip to a nature reserve. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
unrelated to every mentor.reply:
That sounds like a lovely mix of hobbies.
Have a look at [[Hooked By Crochet]] for something creative with yarn, and you can also browse the Societies page to see all the groups available.
What sort of birds do you like to look out for?

only says what they don't want in 3 answ.message: I'm not into sport, clubbing or gaming. I don't like loud nights out. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
only says what they don't want in 3 answ.reply: Thanks for letting me know what you prefer to avoid. What sort of things do you enjoy doing in your spare time?

quiet nights in, not nights out (opposit.message: Reading and films. Quiet nights in, not nights out. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
quiet nights in, not nights out (opposit.reply:
For reading and quiet nights in, you might enjoy [[Book]], [[Film]], or [[Creative Corridor]]. 

What kind of books or films do you most enjoy?

live music (synonym for gigs).message: Live music, mostly indie bands. Seeing a band, then drinks with friends. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
live music (synonym for gigs).reply:
If you enjoy live music and nights out, you might like [[Gigs]] and [[Events]] for things happening at the Students' Union. 

What kind of instruments do you play, or do you prefer being in the audience?

interested in Ukrainian culture, not Ukr.message: I'm not Ukrainian, but I'd love to learn more about Ukrainian culture and meet people. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
interested in Ukrainian culture, not Ukr.reply: You would be very welcome to join [[Ukrainian]], as everyone is welcome to take part. It is a great way to learn about the culture and meet new people. What kind of things do you usually enjoy doing in your spare time?

a mature student.message: I'm a mature student, so I'm a bit older than most people on my course. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
a mature student.reply: That is completely fine and you are definitely not alone here. You might like to take a look at [[Mature Students]] which is for students just like you. What kind of hobbies or interests do you enjoy outside of your studies?

worried about money.message: I'm really worried about money. My loan won't last until the end of term and I don't know what to do.
worried about money.reply: Try not to worry, as there is support available through [[Cost of Living]] and [[Food Pantry]] which can help with money worries and food on campus. Have a look at those pages for practical ways NSU can help right now.

run out of money for food.message: I've run out of money for food this week and I'm not sure what to do.
run out of money for food.reply: I am really sorry to hear that. You can take a look at [[Cost of Living]] and [[Food Pantry]] to help with money worries and getting food.

accused of plagiarism.message: I've been accused of plagiarism in one of my essays and I'm panicking.
accused of plagiarism.reply: Try not to panic, as help is available. You can contact the [[Advice Centre]] for free guidance and support with academic misconduct. Have you had a chance to look at that page yet?

landlord won't fix the damp.message: My landlord won't fix the damp in my flat and keeps ignoring my messages. Can I complain?
landlord won't fix the damp.reply: That sounds really frustrating, and you definitely deserve a proper response from them. Have a look at the [[Advice Centre]] page for guidance on dealing with housing issues and how to raise a formal complaint.

how to contact a suggested society.first: I love knitting and crochet. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
how to contact a suggested society.firstReply: You might really enjoy [[Hooked By Crochet]] or [[Stitch, Make & Bitch]] since they both fit your crafty interests. Have you had a look at your settling-in checklist yet?
how to contact a suggested society.thenReply: You can find out how to contact them by having a look at [[Hooked By Crochet]] or [[Stitch, Make & Bitch]] in the app. Have you had a chance to look at your checklist yet?

how to join a suggested society.first: I'm really into climbing and bouldering. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
how to join a suggested society.firstReply: [[Climbing]] and [[Outdoor Climbing]] would be brilliant for you if you love bouldering and scaling walls. Have you had a chance to check out the [[Sport]] page as well?
how to join a suggested society.thenReply: To find out how to join, take a look at [[Climbing]]. You will find contact buttons and details on its page.

what a suggested society is like.first: I like board games and tabletop role-playing games. Are there any societies for that?
what a suggested society is like.firstReply: For board games and role-playing, you might like [[Gaming and Roleplay]]. Have a look at the Societies page to see what else might fit you.
what a suggested society is like.thenReply: You can check out [[Gaming and Roleplay]] to see what members get up to and how to get in touch.

a suggested society's Instagram.first: I love films and going to the cinema. Are there any societies you'd recommend?
a suggested society's Instagram.firstReply:
Since you enjoy films, you might like [[Film]]. 

What kind of films do you usually watch?
a suggested society's Instagram.thenReply: For details on how to contact or join, take a look at [[Film]].
